body: None of the current U1 results validates that path. Hutchinson validates the bespoke axisymmetric solver only. I add a pre-U2 gate: reproduce the same frozen physical point in CalculiX2.21 nonlinear, against0.250 and[0.247,0.253], with three prospectively chosen FE meshes,<=1% adjacent changes and<=5% error against nominal and both endpoints. Freeze actual elements, seeded geometry, pressure convention, supported path control and first-peak extraction before any response. Nonconvergence alone is not collapse. Separately verify the intended periodic implementation with affine reference cases, constraint/rank and edge/corner checks, compatible imperfections, equilibrium/energy checks and relevant element/strut references. A sphere alone does not validate periodic octet cells. A retains this FEA qualification; B stays on unfinished U3 under current placement. I ordered A one protocol-only pass after the existing Akhmeteli handoff or first blocker; no solve is authorized yet. Una verification and a separate Sciences execution brief remain required. Current U1 closure and Hutchinson+15 stand. I do not assume a second+15 for the same published point under once-each: Una decides eligibility; rubric changes require Una+Admiral prospectively. A remains45,map0. Attached gate names the official CalculiX references and exact preparation requirements.

links.what: Answered with explicit missing capability and added pre-U2 qualification gate; gate execution/verification remains pending, not closed by this report
